findings.body: The test downloads the customer workbook, but `outputDir` does not configure the browser's download location. Playwright accepts downloads into a separate temporary folder by default and only redirects them when `downloadsPath` is configured. Therefore the real-source export is written outside the validated `3f-financial-*` task directory before `createReadStream()` reads it, violating the requirement that customer data exist only in that trusted location. Configure the browser download path to the canonical trusted directory or validate the response without creating an unmanaged browser download. See [Playwright's download contract](https://playwright.dev/docs/next/downloads).
findings.title: Route real-source downloads into the trusted artifact directory

findings.body: The line reporter prints assertion failures to the terminal, while the real-source assertions compare complete report rows, transaction identifiers, memos, and amounts. Any baseline mismatch will consequently emit customer financial data outside the validated artifact directory, despite the comment claiming failure artifacts are contained there. Use sanitized/hash comparisons with detailed differences written only under the trusted directory, or a reporter that keeps failure details there.
findings.title: Prevent real financial rows from appearing in failure output

findings.body: The new `test:e2e` command runs Prettier in check mode before Playwright, but this long `JSON.stringify` interpolation is not formatted according to the repository formatter configuration. The command therefore exits at its formatting prerequisite instead of executing the owned browser test. Format the new spec and verify the registered `test:e2e` command reaches Playwright.

findings.body: This generated review-state file remains outside LEGACY-UI's permitted paths and is not needed for the Playwright setup or baseline proof. It also records now-stale findings and a `fixing` status even though the corresponding provider/destination controls and frontend build change are present. Exclude this workflow artifact from the branch.
